title: What needs a closer look
localOnly: Local files only. No agent or external service is called.
preview: Inspect this selected scope against its connected code folder.
previewLimit: Up to {limit} code files, two recorded dependency hops, and bounded source excerpts. Nothing is changed or sent.
boundary: These are reasons to read, not verified defects or accepted relations.
unavailable: This evidence could not be read safely and consistently.
connectHint: Check the connected source folder, or refresh after the files stop changing. A missing, ambiguous, oversized or changed scope stays unmeasured.
sourceAccessRequired: This app needs permission to read the connected code folder.
sourceAccessHint: Select the connected folder: {path}. You will confirm the inspection afterward.
sourceSelectionFailed: Atlas could not use that folder selection. Select the connected code folder again.
sourceSelectionMismatch: This is not the connected code folder. Select the connected folder to continue.
webLimit: The browser cannot inspect the connected code folder. This local reader runs in the installed app.
webStillWorks: You can still read concept documents and follow recorded relations on the map.
stale: The source, meaning or folder binding changed. These actions are paused until a fresh inspection.
empty: No candidates in this inspected scope
emptyLimit: This does not establish that nothing was overlooked. Unread, omitted and unsupported evidence remains unknown.

kind.missing-link: Code reference absent from the dependency graph
kind.changed-source: Changed source behind a recorded dependency

importFact: A static code reference exists; its directed dependency is absent from the graph.
driftFact: The cited source has a later Git change than its concept document, and a recorded dependent reaches it.
recordedUnknown: This is the author’s recorded gap. It may be historical; its current status has not been verified.
importUnknown: The prose may already explain it. Runtime coupling and business meaning remain unverified.
driftUnknown: A file change does not establish changed meaning or a broken dependent.
readGap: Does this gap still apply? Compare the authored statement with its current source.
readImport: Does this call fit the existing explanation? Start with the caller and imported function.
readDrift: Does the changed code alter the stated promise? Compare that statement and its dependent caller.
noExactPath: No exact source path was authored. Start with this concept’s full Uncertainty section.
prepareBoundary: This prepares an editable request, not an enforced read-only execution mode. Sending uses your chosen provider; writes keep the existing permission review.
capturedSource: Snapshot captured {time}; this is a bounded excerpt, not the whole repository.
candidateCoverage: {total} scoped suggestions · {omitted} beyond the first three. Ordered by proximity, then signal and address.
scanUnavailable: The import scan was not run because a safe complete bounded input could not be established.
limited: Some evidence exceeded the read/scan limit. Absence here is not a clean finding.
coverageUnknown: Dynamic behavior and unsupported languages remain unmeasured. Source excerpts may omit relevant lines. Callers and patterns outside this inspection’s implementation scope are not measured.
sourceFoldersUnknown: This snapshot does not name its implementation folders. It cannot establish coverage of the connected folder.
sessionOnly: Folding lasts only in this inspection. Changed evidence starts a new version.
draftOnly: Editable draft only. You decide whether to send it.
scopeBoundary: Project/domain members extend the selection scope; membership is not evidence of impact.
platformLimit: This secure local reader currently runs in the macOS app. On this platform the evidence remains unmeasured; map and document reading still work.
copyFailed: The clipboard could not be updated. The evidence is unchanged.
localFolderRequired: Open a local ontology folder to inspect its connected code. The sample has no local source binding.
draftLead:
{subject}
{question} Explain the current evidence and unknowns without changing files.

continuation.title: Analysis in this scope
continuation.notInspected: Not inspected against current code. Open this investigation when you want to look closer.
continuation.knownSuggestions: {count} reasons to investigate in the last bounded inspection. Their current meaning remains unverified.
continuation.scopeBoundary: This status covers only the selected scope and captured evidence. It does not measure how complete or correct the whole ontology is.
continuation.transfer: Send this question and selected evidence to {runtime}. Your agent may read more code and use its configured provider. Changes require permission review. Your provider may charge for this analysis.
continuation.reportedTasks: Agent-reported tasks: {done} of {total}. This is task status, not verified ontology coverage.
continuation.busy: The current conversation is working or waiting for your approval. Return to it before starting another analysis.
continuation.partial: This analysis stopped before all requested evidence was read. Review its findings and unknowns before choosing the next question.
continuation.result: Analysis result available. Its claims still need review; this does not mark the gap resolved.
continuation.review: Meaning changes are waiting for your review. Analysis completion does not approve them.
continuation.previousResult: Previous result from {time}. The current source or meaning may differ; inspect again before using it for a change.
continuation.agentUnavailable: A ready coding agent with a verified permission guard is required. Choose one in the Agent panel, or prepare an editable investigation request.
continuation.localUnavailable: Code analysis with the local model is not available in this app yet. Choose a coding agent or copy an investigation for your terminal.
continuation.replanned: The agent changed its reported task total to {total}. Earlier task counts do not measure this revised plan or ontology completeness.
continuation.scopeLabel: Scope: {scope}. A recorded project covers its recorded members, not every code behavior.
continuation.chooseScope: Choose a concept, set or project to inspect. No scope is selected, so analysis status is unknown.
continuation.emptyVault: No concepts are recorded yet. Use Build from code to create the first map when you are ready.
continuation.packetLimits: These limits describe the evidence already captured. They do not limit the coding agent’s later reads or cost. You can stop the analysis.
continuation.matchUnknown: This saved result cannot be matched to this question and evidence version. You can read it in history; it does not count as this scope’s analysis result.
continuation.saveUnavailable: This answer is visible in the conversation, but saving its analysis record failed. It is not credited as a saved result.
continuation.refused: This investigation did not start. Check the selected evidence and the agent’s permission mode, then try again explicitly.
continuation.improvementLead: Prepare a reviewable improvement for this question. Keep the answer’s unknowns and current evidence visible.
continuation.historyLimited: Some history was not read or could not be verified. Missing matches do not mean no earlier analysis exists.
continuation.narrowScope: This scope is unavailable or too large for this inspection. Choose a smaller recorded concept or set.
continuation.modelUnknown: The active model is not confirmed here. Check it in the Agent panel.
